title: 联想CFO温斯顿：全年营收目标1000亿美元，上半年已超500亿
speaker: Winston Chang

segments.en: out all the fancy accounting stuff. Relative to, so you're six months into your fiscal year, where are you relative to your full-year target as far as revenue goes?
segments.zh: 撇开那些花哨的会计处理。相对而言，你们财年已过六个月，收入方面距离全年目标进展如何？

segments.en: Yeah, we have a full-year target of, well, I think a two-year target of over $100 billion.
segments.zh: 是的，我们有一个全年目标，嗯，我认为是两年目标超过1000亿美元。

segments.en: We've already done greater than $50 billion in the first half of this year.
segments.zh: 今年上半年我们已经完成了超过500亿美元。

segments.en: So I think we're well on track of that goal and it's very likely that we'll exceed that goal of $100 billion in this current fiscal year.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们正稳步推进该目标，而且本财年很可能超过1000亿美元的目标。

segments.en: Okay. Okay. Do I sense that you'll need to maybe up, you know, raise it?
segments.zh: 好的。好的。我是不是可以理解为你们可能需要上调指引？

segments.en: At what point does it make sense for you to go, you know, that's going to be easy work now?
segments.zh: 到什么时候你们会觉得，嗯，那将是轻而易举的事？

segments.en: Well, internally, you'll see that our infrastructure business grew 175% year on year.
segments.zh: 嗯，内部来看，我们的基础设施业务同比增长了175%。

segments.en: And so that business continues to show a lot of strength, given that the global demand for compute remains robust.
segments.zh: 因此，鉴于全球计算需求依然强劲，该业务继续展现出强劲势头。

segments.en: And so on that basis, we've actually already internally adjust the target up for the ISG business.
segments.zh: 因此，基于这一点，我们实际上已经在内部上调了ISG业务的目标。
